_comment: The current targeting snapshot, loaded by `manage.py targeting_import --from-manifest`. Rebuilding this dataset from source costs 30-45 minutes of API calls and can exhaust WorldPop's daily quota for everyone else, so a new environment should restore from here rather than re-fetch. Pin a new drive_file_id whenever the dataset changes materially: export, upload to the folder below (shared with connect-labs-sa), and update the id, created_at and counts in one commit so the file and the record stay together.
notes: Restore with: make manage CMD="targeting_import --from-manifest" (needs LABS_SYNTHETIC_GDRIVE_SA_KEY; already in the ECS task definition, and locally readable from Secrets Manager as labs-jj-synthetic-gdrive-sa-key with the labs AWS profile). ADM2 population is now half loaded (742 of 1,518 admin-2 boundaries have pop_u1, against 0 two days ago), which is what moved births from a thin floor to a usable figure: 1,496 of 1,954 births rows now come from the measured infant cohort rather than the fertility fallback, and a subnational U5MR selection carries a births figure for 285 of 307 units against 78 before. The remaining 776 admin-2 boundaries are WorldPop daily-quota bound.
